content.text:
Everything is pushed to `KartikKrishnan05/tacto_challenge` on `main` (commit `439b6ed`), and your local branch matches GitHub.

- **The warning:** `negotiation-arena-kit` was its own git repo, a clone of `tacto-ai/negotiation-arena-kit`, so `git add .` would only have saved a pointer to it, not its files. It had no local changes or unpushed commits. I moved its inner `.git` folder out of the way and committed the 324 files as normal files in your repo.
- **Left out on purpose:** the kit's own `.gitignore` kept `.venv/`, `__pycache__`, caches and any real `.env` out of the commit. The largest file committed is `data/world.sqlite` at 3.3 MB.
- **Teammate's change:** Maximilian had pushed a commit adding `.env` rules to `.gitignore`, so the first push was rejected. I rebased onto his commit and fixed the conflict. `.gitignore` now keeps his secrets rules and no longer ignores `negotiation-arena-kit/`.

The kit's old `.git` folder is in my scratch directory. Without it, you can't `git pull` updates from tacto-ai inside that folder. If you need a newer kit version later, re-clone it somewhere else and copy the files over.
